fb-guard regularly checks your FRITZ!Box: fb-guard regularly checks your FRITZ!Box for failed logins, open ports, outdated firmware and weak settings, and tells you via Telegram or e-mail.

How critical a user is depends on its ri:
How critical a user is depends on its rights. The box does not report them through its interface, please check yourself:
• Smart home only: can switch devices (sockets, heating) but not change the box. Rather low.
• NAS only: access to files on the box storage. Low to medium, depending on the content.
• FRITZ!Box settings: full access to the box. High.
In any case more critical if "access from the internet" is on or the password is weak. Still delete unused accounts, each one is another password someone can guess.

Low risk. WireGuard only answers packets: Low risk. WireGuard only answers packets with a valid key. A port scan sees nothing and there is no password to guess. Remaining risk: bugs in the WireGuard software of the target (keep it updated) and lost devices holding a key (e.g. an old phone) – delete peers you no longer use.
